mapper.sql: select s.sys_id as subscription_sys_id, s.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, s.owner_user_sys_id, u.user_id as owner_user_id, u.user_nm as owner_user_nm, u.user_role as owner_user_role, s.status, pay.payment_nm as plan_name, s.amount, s.paid_through_at, s.grace_until, s.end_at, s.expired_at, s.role_granted_yn, s.payment_method_status, s.provider_end_status, s.last_failure_code, (select count(*) from sys_subscription_invoice i where i.subscription_sys_id = s.sys_id and (i.apply_result in ('MISMATCH', 'OWNER_MISSING') or (i.apply_result in ('STALE', 'AFTER_CANCEL') and i.status <> 'REFUNDED'))) as problem_count from sys_subscription s left join sys_plant p on p.plant_cd = s.plant_cd and p.delete_yn = 'N' left join sys_user u on u.sys_id = s.owner_user_sys_id left join sys_payment pay on pay.sys_id = s.plan_sys_id
